text:
zoe: quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning — want to lock owners/timelines for remediation + SLO/SLA handling. recurring late-night throughput collapses, we need a plan.
dan: TL;DR numbers?
zoe: during the incident p95 ~180ms steady, p99 spiked to ~1.8s for ~30m (03:10-03:40 UTC), throughput dropped from ~25rps to ~6rps. rolling-week error-budget burn jumped ~22%. pattern happens ~weekly, looks correlated with nightly compaction + sudden client bursts.
frank: i've seen this 3x in the last month. interestingly the model pool churn + a few large fanout requests correlate.
perf-bot: incident-3123456789 created: https://incidents.redwood/3123456789 — severity P2, linked to backlog-queue-regressions. :white_check_mark:
zoe: mitigation ideas (brain dump):
  1) ephemeral-warm pool: keep a tiny set of pre-warmed workers that never scale-to-zero (frank)
  2) degraded-route: automatic fallback to a lightweight model variant when p99>1s for >2m (no global SLO change; route-level graceful degradation)
  3) adaptive burst token limiter at edge to smooth spikes from single clients (infra-oncall)
  4) dashboard + error-budget projection + per-customer SLA widget (dan)
  5) long-term: tuning autoscaler cooldowns and compaction jitter (infra)
dan: prefer degraded-route over loosening SLOs. that keeps SLA semantics intact and gives CS time to communicate. owners + deadlines?
zoe: proposed owners: frank - ephemeral-warm prototype by Mon and staging canary Tue; infra-oncall - token-bucket prototype by Wed; dan - dashboard + burn projection + SLA widget by Thu EOD; zoe - runbook + SLO fallback policy draft by Fri.
frank: ephemeral-warm plan: small pool flagged "ephemeral_warm=true" in pool-manager, will keep 3 instances warm per region. canary schedule: Tue 03:00 staging, Thu 03:00 prod (low-traffic fallback).
infra-oncall: token limiter design: per-customer burst tokens with refill rate tuned to average traffic. prototype to infra repo, canary Thu if kernel-level hooks fine. question: any routes we should exempt?
cs: exempt internal/personalization calls that are single-tenant and have strong SLA needs. we'll provide list. also we need a short customer note template if degraded-route might touch SLA customers.
dan: dashboard draft query (prometheus) i'll add to the panel: 
```
# p99 split by route variant and degraded flag for /v1/generate
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, model_variant, route_degraded))
```
dan: will also add a burn projection panel: current_rate * 24h -> days-to-zero.
frank: did a quick staging replay with ephemeral warm pool enabled — p99 spikes reduced ~50% in the window. attaching artifact to the incident.
perf-bot: action items added to incident checklist: frank(ephemeral-warm), infra-oncall(token-limiter), dan(dashboard), zoe(runbook). Deadlines recorded.
zoe: decision check — keep global SLOs as-is, implement degraded-route fallback + ephemeral-warm + token limiter. notify SLA customers only if degraded-route is exercised for >1h cumulatively. agree? react with :thumbsup: to approve.
dan: :thumbsup:
frank: :thumbsup:
infra-oncall: :thumbsup:
cs: :thumbsup:
zoe: great. i'll draft the exec 1-pager and a short customer note template. if any owner hits a blocker, please flag here and we'll escalate. :mag:
